name: as_of_month_day is ignored under a week row axis because the week branch wins
description: Under both axes the week branch of keeptradecut_join takes the boundary, so a well-formed as_of_month_day reaches params and does not affect the emitted boundary: the SQL must carry to_timestamp(nfl_year_week_timestamp.week_timestamp) and no make_date at all, and no recency floor, which is year-axis only. This is the accepted-and-ignored shape recorded in the plan -- accepted only because the client control hides itself under a week axis, so the state is reachable solely by removing a year axis from a saved view. The alias still differs from the unset one, so a stale param emits an identical join under a different alias: wasteful, not wrong. A MALFORMED value is a different case and throws.
expected_query: with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2000,2001,2002,2003,2004,2005,2006,2007,2008,2009,2010,2011,2012,2013,2014,2015,2016,2017,2018,2019,2020,2021,2022,2023,2024,2025,2026]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years), "player_years_weeks" as (SELECT player_years.pid, nfl_year_week_timestamp.year, nfl_year_week_timestamp.week FROM player_years INNER JOIN nfl_year_week_timestamp ON player_years.year = nfl_year_week_timestamp.year), "t568be828d136ab4becd57df879ae0fba" as (with recursive ktc_pid_scan as ((select pid from keeptradecut_valuations order by pid limit 1) union all select (select ktc_next.pid from keeptradecut_valuations ktc_next where ktc_next.pid > ktc_pid_scan.pid order by ktc_next.pid limit 1) from ktc_pid_scan where ktc_pid_scan.pid is not null) select pid from ktc_pid_scan where pid is not null), "t8527a0700916a0ba35cb31a763c8bd62" as (select ktc_p.pid, ktc_w.year, ktc_w.week, ktc_latest.keeptradecut_value from t568be828d136ab4becd57df879ae0fba ktc_p cross join (select distinct ktc_pyw.year, ktc_pyw.week, ktc_ts.week_timestamp from player_years_weeks ktc_pyw inner join nfl_year_week_timestamp ktc_ts on ktc_ts.year = ktc_pyw.year and ktc_ts.week = ktc_pyw.week) ktc_w cross join lateral (select ktc_src.keeptradecut_value from keeptradecut_valuations ktc_src where ktc_src.pid = ktc_p.pid and ktc_src.is_superflex = true and ktc_src.keeptradecut_value is not null and ktc_src.observed_at <= to_timestamp(ktc_w.week_timestamp) order by
